# Architecture

- Layer 1 is responsible for part 1 of the write path.
- Layer 2 is responsible for part 2 of the write path.
- Layer 3 is responsible for part 3 of the write path.
- Layer 4 is responsible for part 4 of the write path.
- Layer 5 is responsible for part 5 of the write path.
- Layer 6 is responsible for part 6 of the write path.

- Layer 15 is responsible for part 15 of the write path.
- Layer 16 is responsible for part 16 of the write path.
- Layer 17 is responsible for part 17 of the write path.
- Layer 18 is responsible for part 18 of the write path.

| Layer | Module |
| --- | --- |
| admission | `src/api.ts` |
| journal | `src/journal.ts` |
| projection | `src/projector.ts` |
